blocks.text: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is a law in the European Union that protects personal data. It sets rules on how organizations collect, store, and use data. GDPR requires transparency, consent, and the right to access or delete personal information. Many countries and companies follow similar standards to ensure data privacy globally. These frameworks aim to prevent misuse of personal information and promote accountability.
